messages:
maria: Handoff for tonight's VIP billing migration window — Thu 23:00-02:00 PST. Primary oncall please monitor billing-proxy  and billing-ingest queues. Expected: short spike during DB cutover and a heavy write batch from OmegaCorp ~01:10. Leave alerts low-sensitivity for early warning. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/billing-migration-watch. I'll be available on mobile but will be briefly offline 00:30-01:00 for maintenance. :warning:

jordan: Ack. I'll take primary at 22:45. Setting up alert overrides now. Can you paste the prometheus queries you want us to watch? :eyes:

maria: Sure — key queries: 
```
sum(increase(billing_queue_length[5m]))
rate(billing_500_count[5m])
sum(rate(billing_retry_backoff_total[5m]))
```
Watch queue_growth > 200/min and 500s > 0.5% for any sustained 10m window.

sam: Who's the escalation chain if payment service keeps failing beyond quick fixes? Need to know for handoff notes to sales.

nisha: Escalation: pager -> eng-sre lead (lee) -> product ops (sam) -> account exec (sales-lead). Contract SLA with OmegaCorp: 99.95% uptime; severity-1 must be acknowledged within 30m. If we're trending, notify sales + CS immediately. :phone:

oncall-bot: Reminder: runbook "billing-migration-watch" pinned in channel. Quick steps: 1) verify canary at 1% 2) watch queues 3) confirm DB replica lag <5s. Playbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/billing-migration-watch

lee: I'll cover 00:00-02:30 and be escalation point. Jordan — can you confirm canary rollout plan for the first 30m so I know what to expect?

jordan: Canary plan: 1% for 15m, 10% for 15m, then 100% if stable. If errors spike at any step, pause and rollback. Will post the infra command in #eng-infra before starting.

ops-bot: Note: perf warmup scheduled at 22:30 -> brief 1k rps ramp to billing-proxy to prime caches. Logs output to #eng-infra. :rocket:

sam: Ops note — backlog flush procedure if queue backlog grows: run `python tools/flush_backlog.py --max 2000` from infra bastion. If backlog >5000 for 10m, escalate immediately.

maria: FYI — OmegaCorp runs a price-change batch at 01:10 hitting write path. Coordinate with Product to pause or rate-limit if queue starts to back up. I'll message product ops when we approach that window.

lee: Thanks — I'll keep Sales/CS posted and update the status channel if anything looks risky. Will also be ready to trigger manual DB failover if replication lag grows.

nisha: tagging @sales-lead for visibility and to prep customer comms just in case. :eyes:

jordan: Pinging infra-ops to confirm standby replica is ready for manual failover. @infra-ops please ack.

infra-ops: Acked. Standby replica caught up as of 22:15. Manual failover steps tested and documented in runbook.

maria: Final handoff notes: if sustained 5xx >2% for 15m -> rollback billing-proxy to `billing-proxy:v1.4.3`, open an incident in #incidents and notify account team. Also capture traces and set `billing_trace_sampling=1.0` for 10m to help root cause.

lee: Got it. Will take action if thresholds hit. Thanks for the detailed handoff. :thumbsup:

maria: Handing off now. Jordan is primary at 22:45. I'll be on mobile; call me if anything critical. Good luck everyone.
